summary: Layer 1B expanded the universe around the K-12 virtual schooling and career-learning operating stack using a two-lane funnel. Stride is retained as the reference asset because its filings directly map to full-service online K-12 and career-learning delivery. The underfollowed lane adds Nelnet as a second-order K-12 operating-stack supplier through FACTS and education technology/payments, Lincoln Educational Services as a small/mid-cap career-training execution asset with hybrid delivery exposure, and Adtalem as a healthcare workforce education platform tied to regulated credential pathways.
